title: Russian Formalism, 1919–1930 — OPOJAZ's Poetika (1919), Shklovsky, Tynyanov, Eikhenbaum
edition: Поэтика. Сборники по теории поэтического языка, I–II (Петроград: 18-я Государственная типография, 1919): О. Брик, Е. Поливанов, В. Шкловский, Б. Эйхенбаум, Л. Шкловский, Техника писательского ремесла (Москва: Молодая гвардия, 1930)

scope: Shklovsky's Воскрешение слова (1914), Zoo (1923), Ход коня (1923) and Третья фабрика (1926) were not located on the reachable sources; QUEUED. Архаисты и новаторы (Tynyanov, 1929) is on the Internet Archive only in a scan filed under 1985 and is not seated until its printing is established. Jakobson's Новейшая русская поэзия (Prague, 1921) not located; QUEUED. Text layers are the Internet Archive's OCR, uncorrected; the scans are the witnesses.
verified_loci: Poetika (1919) — Shklovsky, «Искусство как прием» (Art as Device), the essay that names остранение
О теории прозы (1929) — остранение (estrangement), in the text layer
Tynyanov, Достоевский и Гоголь — 'к теории пародии'
why_seated: Shklovsky's device, and the school that read Futurism (card 18/03) as it happened: «Искусство как прием» is the theory of what zaum and parole in libertà do — make the word strange so it can be seen. Tynyanov's parody essay is the theory of the move the archive's heteronymic practice makes.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "we need more seatings of avant garde literature. dada. farce. oulipo. futurist. - whatevers in the public domain. originals is good on classics, impoverished on modern. and i want the italian troubadours. and pound, more pound. need the cantos." — "and the concrete poets" — "also need jarry, shklovsky, etc" — "it gets an ea-corpora deposit and a spine and a card on tll, bulk seatings per ea-corpora deposit is fine".
